protocol.name: zoom_etis_v1
protocol.purpose: One-time evaluation on a polyp dataset that was never used in this project (ETIS-LaribPolypDB, 196 images). The accepted Kvasir-trained checkpoints (baseline and detail branch, five seeds) are evaluated with single-pass inference and with the locked two-pass zoom configuration. Nothing is trained, selected or tuned.

dataset.pairing: images/<id>.tif with masks/p<id>.tif, as listed in the manifest
dataset.preprocessing: none; the original TIFF files are read directly

protocol.prompt: a polyp in a colonoscopy image

zoom.fusion: second-pass map replaces the first inside the window; zero outside; first pass kept if the second is empty

gate.description: Fixed before any prediction on this dataset was computed. Two-pass minus single-pass DSC of the detail-branch model, percentage points, mean over the five seeds of the per-seed mean over images.

reported_not_gating: two-pass gain of the baseline arm
detail branch minus baseline, with single-pass and with two-pass inference
NSD, failures (DSC below 50%), results by lesion size, share of images with a second pass
image-level bootstrap intervals and sign-flip permutation tests on seed-averaged differences
rules: The evaluation is run once. Its result is reported whatever the outcome.
A paused or interrupted job is rerun from its start with the same seeds; completed jobs are never recomputed.
disclosures: ETIS-Larib was not used for training, model selection or any analysis in this project before this evaluation.
Patient-level independence from the training data and absence from the pre-training data of the frozen encoders cannot be established from the archive.
The dataset has one acquisition source; every image contains a polyp.
